title: 電波工学
subtitle: Microwave Engineering
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will learn about the transfer of energy by electromagnetic waves and the radiation of electromagnetic waves, and perform basic calculations on electromagnetic waves.
In addition, students will learn the basics of wireless communication systems that apply radio waves.
advice:
The class covers the following items.

1. Electromagnetic waves and their applications
2. Transmission of energy by electromagnetic waves
3. Radiation of electromagnetic waves
4. Electromagnetic wave behavior at media boundaries
5. Radio wave propagation in the atmosphere
7. Transmitter and receiver
8. Radar system
books: M. Takahashi, Introduction of Electromagnetic Wave Engineering, Suurikougaku-sha Co.,Ltd., 2011.
requiredKnowledge:
1. Before studying this subject, it is necessary to master and understand "Electromagnetics I", "Electromagnetics II", and "Electromagnetics III".
2. Be sure to answer and submit your own exercises in each chapter.
3. Understand and store definitions and meanings of technical terms properly.
4. Review the contents of the text and slides carefully in the class to clearly distinguish what you have understood and what you can not do, and ask questions

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept and role of radio waves and explain the mechanism applied.
Understand the nature and propagation of electromagnetic waves and perform basic calculations.
Understand the concept of antenna and calculate basic characteristics.
Understand the behavior of electromagnetic waves and explain typical concepts.
Understand the basics of radio wave propagation and explain typical concepts.
Understand the mechanism of radio wave application and explain the general outline.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will be able to fully explain the properties and propagation of electromagnetic waves, the concept of antennas, and basic calculations about the characteristics of electromagnetic waves and antennas.
achievementLevels.standard: Students will be able to understand the concept, role, and application mechanism of radio waves, explain the properties and propagation of electromagnetic waves, and the concept of antennas, and make basic calculations about the characteristics of electromagnetic waves and antennas.
